jobs.employer_name: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
jobs.description: About the roleJoin us as our Team Lead Technical Operations and help shape the reliability, resilience, and future of DIGITEC’s SaaS operations!DIGITEC is a leading provider of Foreign Exchange SaaS solutions, specializing in FX Swaps, NDFs, and Money Markets. We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Team Lead Technical Operations to lead our TechOps team and ensure the reliable, secure, resilient, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms .In this role, you will combine technical leadership, people development, and operational ownership, leading a multinational TechOps team of four people based across Hamburg, London, and Singapore. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will play a key role in evolving our operations from manual and infrastructure-centric processes toward a more automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native environment, applying SRE and Operational Excellence principles.You will work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to continuously improve how we operate our platforms and deliver reliable services to our clients.Your ResponsibilitiesTechnical Operations & Reliability• Lead the reliable, resilient, secure, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.• Drive service reliability using SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, and reliability engineering.• Oversee incident, problem, and escalation management while strengthening Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and technical resilience.Operational Excellence & Transformation• Drive the evolution toward automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native operations.• Continuously improve operational processes, tooling, automation, and KPIs to increase reliability and efficiency.• Promote a culture of Operational Excellence, continuous improvement, and effective problem management.Team Leadership & Collaboration• Lead and develop our multinational TechOps team across Hamburg, London, and Singapore, fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.• Provide technical and operational direction while remaining hands-on where needed.• Work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to align priorities, solve operational challenges, and continuously improve our services.Preferred qualifications• Several years of experience operating business-critical SaaS and cloud applications, combined with proven leadership experience in technical teams.• Strong hands-on experience with SRE and Operational Excellence, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, automation, operational KPIs, and continuous improvement.• Solid experience with incident, problem, and escalation management in production environments.• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, networking, operating systems, and containerization.• Good knowledge of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, technical resilience, and security principles relevant to SaaS operations.• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.• A hands-on and proactive mindset, with the willingness to understand the technical details of our D3 product family.• Fluent English skills.Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:• ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.• Experience with AIOps, operational automation, or cloud-native transformation.• Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services.• German language skills.What we offer as an employer• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.• Be part of an international work force: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.• Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.• Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.• Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.Our commitment to inclusion:We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders and identities, and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive teamAbout usDIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH stands at the forefront of the financial technology sector, renowned for developing cutting-edge software solutions. Our innovative products encompass a wide spectrum, from pricing and settlement solutions for FX/MM businesses to FX market data services. With over 40 prominent banks worldwide, spanning Europe, America, Asia, and Australia, among our esteemed clientele, we have solidified our position as a global leader.At the heart of our success is our exceptional team, comprised of approximately 80 dedicated professionals boasting expertise in software development, financial mathematics, sales, IT systems, and more. Operating from three key locations—Hamburg (headquarters), London, and Singapore—we champion equal opportunities and foster a culture of respect and collaboration, ensuring a welcoming and supportive work environment for all.Join us as we continue to redefine the landscape of financial technology with DIGITEC.

jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Test Means Design Team in Bremen, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aPMT Leader Test Means (d/f/m)The Test Means Design Team in Bremen is one of four transnational Design Offices focused on Test Means Design and Integration for Flight Test (FTI) and Lab Test Means (LTM). FTI prepares development aircraft to perform tests essential for the development, improvement, and certification of our aircraft. A key challenge for LTM is aligning industrial bench standards with the aircraft environment of the examinees.The Bremen team is responsible for the customized engineering of Functional Electric (FE) and Test System Installation (ESI/MSI). Working across several programs and MSNs, team members are required to have strong proficiency in the relevant toolsets.In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide operational support to the Design Office regarding Process, Methods, and Tools (PMT), specifically for Functional Electrical design activities. Additionally, you will serve as the PMT focal point for the specification, testing, and deployment of new solutions within a transnational framework.Your locationBremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Starting with operational support to the FE team in their day-to-day work, specifically regarding Process, Methods, and Tooling issues- Acting as the focal point for all FE design toolsets, across all programs and National Companies (NatCos)- Participating in the deployment of any new Airbus tools within the various teams (Design, Business, etc.)- Serving as a Business Representative within the context of digital transformation projects- Acting as a key reference point for the usage of FE design tools- Gathering requirements to support the creation of new tools- Regular travels between Airbus Sites are expectedDesired skills and qualifications- You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aeronautics or equivalent- You already have ideally practical experience in Design or Functional Electric and corresponding PLM Toolsets, like: CAPITAL, CORE ELEC, CIRCE, SEE XP, ESDCR, CCD, TAKSY, ELSY- Knowledge of Electrical Functional Design would be a valuable asset for your application.- You are autonomous, inquisitive, and proactive- You are open-minded and possess strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to step back from day-to-day activities to propose new ideas- Working at Airbus involves operating in an international environment; therefore, you must be able to communicate fluently in English. (French is a plus)- You have already solid experience in project management and are capable of switching between different topics while maintaining a strong team spirit- Good knowledge of tool development and LBIP+ Methodology is an assetNot a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
